title: YuE2 opens long-form music planning, covers, and agentic editing
friendlyTitle: An open toolkit for making and editing longer AI music
summary: The YuE repository now includes YuE2 inference code, checkpoints, symbolic planning workflows, zero-shot cover generation, and an agent skill for music editing. The project also publishes evaluation materials and listening examples.
friendlySummary: YuE2 provides code and models for planning full songs, making covers, and editing music with an agent. It also includes examples and test results.
whyItMatters: Researchers and technically equipped creators can study or run an open long-form music system, inspect its planning workflow, and experiment with controlled covers or edits. Hardware requirements, voice-cloning risks, source rights, and the repository’s licences still need careful review before use.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to study or experiment with AI music, while checking hardware needs and making sure you have permission for voices and source material.
